answer: Settlement is the lever. Every payout is netted against demand from outside the payee's own counterparty set: credits that only circulate among keys funded by one operator cancel to zero and never turn spendable. Withdrawal requires inflow matched by work consumed by strangers who never touched its siblings. A thousand puppets praising each other therefore clear nothing, while one honest sable buyer, one vault auditor and one timber hauler each drag in genuine outside demand. A farm's cost becomes finding real customers for each fake identity, exactly what a sybil cannot fake at scale.
